summary.en: A title slams in and splits into two ink plates out of register; they shake twice, decaying, and snap into register with a pulse.
summary.zh: 标题撞进来的一瞬裂成两块没对准的油墨印版，衰减着抖两下，“啪”地套准，带一下轻脉冲。

fits: The hit on a title or a word in a paper, print or poster style: the one landing a viewer should feel, once or twice a film.
notFor: Screen styles (use impact-frame); small text; every title of a film (two at most).

intent.en: A hit in the language of print: the plates slip out of register and snap back, so the landing feels like ink stamped on paper, not a screen glitch.
intent.zh: 用印刷的语言打一拳：两块印版错位再“啪”地套准，命中像在纸上盖了一枚油墨章，而不是屏幕故障。

content.en: One large title or word (≤ 20 chars, 200–300 px), optionally over a scene.
content.zh: 一行大标题或一个词（≤ 8 字，字号 200–300 px），可叠在场景上。

fits.zh: 纸张、印刷或海报风格里标题或词的那一下命中：观众该感到的落点，一支片一两次。

notFor.zh: 屏幕感的风格（用 impact-frame）；小字；片中每个标题都用（最多两次）。

en: The slip must be large enough to see: about 20 px per plate (40 px apart) on a 200–300 px title; ±5 px is invisible at speed.
Mix directions, mostly sideways with a little vertical; purely sideways reads as a wobble.
Paper films take this, screen films take impact-frame; never both in one film.
zh: 错位要大到看得见：200–300 px 的大标题每版约 20 px（总分离 40 px）；±5 px 在正常速度下看不见。
方向一横一纵混合，以横为主、纵向少量；纯横向读作左右晃动。
纸墨调性用它、屏幕调性用 impact-frame，同片不并用。

upstream.use: 标题/卡片的命中强调，纸墨审美版的"故障闪"；全片 1–2 次的单发高潮
